title: Mr. Brightside
headline: Brandon Flowers never found a second verse for Mr. Brightside
caption:
Brandon Flowers and Dave Keuning played the Killers' "Mr. Brightside" at an open-mic night at Cafe Roma in Las Vegas, their first performance together as the Killers. It was half of a two-song set, and Flowers has said of it, "It was terrible, awful."

An early demo had Keuning on bass and Matt Norcross on drums, before Mark Stoermer and Ronnie Vannucci joined, and the original demo finally came out officially on the 2013 compilation Direct Hits. In 2002 the band also handed out a demo of the song for free at their shows.

🎧 The song: "Mr. Brightside" by The Killers (@thekillers)

comment: About the song, the mix on Hot Fuss began as a quick reference mix done in just over half an hour, and the band preferred it to all the later remixes.
